{{Quote|In the Dantooine System, locals say there are still acts of theft being committed within the Dantooine System. 'We're trying to clean the mess up as soon as possible', Major Jen Kynlaz says. 'It's unfortunate that the locals have to bring themselves this low'.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
'''Jen Kynlaz''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] Jen Kynlaz was concerned about acts of theft and looting being committed by [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jen Kynlaz was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Jen Kynlaz was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />
